_comment: Smart Cauldron conductor ruleset v1.3. Rules are evaluated top-down; first match wins (ANY-of match on tags). defaultEntry fires when no rule matches. woClass/tags are supplied entirely by the CLI caller via --class/--tags (smart-cauldron does not parse WO frontmatter itself) -- a WO 'acquires' a tag only if the caller passes it explicitly on the command line. 2026-07-07: mechanical CODE work now routes to zero, an exhaustion lane with no paid review seat. Money/auth/infra stay on the stronger lane.
